(2) A person's hand enters the frame, holding a small, peach-colored bottle with a white cap against a neutral, grey tiled wall background, likely a bathroom. The hand rotates the bottle to show the label, which features purple text and a circular logo. (3) The scene shifts to a slightly blurred background as the hand shakes the bottle vigorously up and down. The movement is rapid, creating a blurry effect on the hand and bottle. The lighting remains bright and even. (4) The bottle is opened, and the person uses their other hand to dispense a single drop of pinkish-beige, opaque liquid onto their index fingertip. The camera is in a close-up shot, capturing the texture and color of the liquid clearly. (5) A macro close-up of a person's chin reveals several red, inflamed acne spots. The finger gently dabs the treatment liquid onto one of the spots. The person wears an orange-red shirt, visible in the lower part of the frame. The camera captures the application process across multiple spots, emphasizing the thick layer described in the overlays. (7) The video concludes with a full-screen graphic on a pink background. It displays the logo of Japanuts, social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, and a website URL. Icons for like, comment, and share are at the bottom.
